description: Query normalized FAST-41 federal permitting project inventory rows from Homecastr's public R2-backed permit surface. Use for project status, sector, agency, state, and location filters; do not use it for milestone-date settlement until the full FAST-41 dataset is normalized.

limit.description: Maximum projects to return, capped at 5000. Defaults to 100.

sector.description: Optional sector text filter, e.g. 'Electricity Transmission', 'Renewable Energy', or 'Surface Transportation'.

status.description: Optional status text filter, e.g. 'In Progress', 'Complete', or 'Paused'.

summary.description: If true, returns manifest and count metadata without row payloads.

name: get_fast41_projects

result.description: Raw JSON response body returned by the Homecastr API.

title: Get Fast41 Projects
